rule.name: ScheduledTaskStopsOnFailure
rule.message: This task is scheduled on a ScheduledExecutorService with scheduleAtFixedRate or scheduleWithFixedDelay and its body does I/O (a repository, database, REST or messaging call) without catching Exception, RuntimeException or Throwable. When one run throws, the executor suppresses every later run and keeps the exception in a ScheduledFuture nobody reads, so nothing is logged and the task silently stops until the process restarts. A failing database or remote call is a matter of time. Wrap the whole body in a try block with catch (RuntimeException e) that logs the failure, so the next run still happens. An exception fits a task that must stop on its first failure, in which case keep the returned future and handle its failure.
